issues.details: chrome/header-desktop.png is only 1,090 bytes for a 1440×150 PNG (virtually all zero pixels, 159 non-black/white bytes out of 648,150). The header element was found to have a 0-height bounding box at render time, meaning the cropped screenshot is a near-transparent/blank slice. However, header.html itself is 43 KB with 27 links and full nav markup — the HTML capture is valid and complete. The blank screenshot is a cosmetic artifact of how the header crop was taken (zero-height bounding box), not a pre-hydration capture failure.
issues.remediation: Re-capture the header screenshot by scrolling to or forcing a viewport that shows the rendered header with non-zero height, or crop from a full-page homepage screenshot instead.
